title: Veterans Pension Care-Cost Adjustments — Ongoing or Ended Care and the Months Counted
content:
# Months over which care is counted — Veterans Pension care-cost rate adjustment

**Clause.** In a care-cost rate adjustment the monthly care figure is counted over a number of months. The test reads the care months reported in the 3 whole months before the adjustment and, for the most recent care month (the report with the latest expense period start), the days from the end of its expense period to the date that report reached VA — the ongoing-care gap is 92 days.

| Care months reported | Most recent care month ended | Care is | Months counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| at least 3 | no more than 92 days before its report reached VA (a month ending on or after the date of receipt included) | ongoing | 12 |
| at least 3 | more than 92 days before its report reached VA | ended | one for each care month reported |
| fewer than 3 | — | — | 1 (counted once) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; four care months reported)

| Most recent care month ended | Report reached VA | Gap | Months counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 30 | September 30 | 92 days | 12 |
| June 30 | October 1 | 93 days | 4 |
| June 30 | June 15 | ended after receipt | 12 |

With two care months reported, the figure is counted once, whatever the gap.
